result.reasoning: This commit ("added use of try-with-resource") introduced the try-with-resources block around the ResultSet in getAll/allWithDataStream and getValues methods in SimpleJDBCRecordStore.java. This causes the ResultSet to be closed immediately upon returning from the try block, before the returned Stream (which lazily reads from the ResultSet) can be consumed by the caller — the exact bug the fix commit addresses by reverting to non-try-with-resource handling with a comment explaining the ResultSet must stay open. The blame on both changed hunks (getAll query and getValues) points directly to this commit as introducing the flawed try-with-resource usage.
